decision_conditions: <p>The proposed green roof to the leisure room hereby approved shall be installed in the first available planting season following the substantial implementation of the outbuilding.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Reason: To ensure the biodiversity and design benefits of the proposed development are achieved.&nbsp;</p>

Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.

Construction Times (Minor Development) - No demolition or construction work or ancillary activities such as deliveries shall take place before 8am or after 6pm Mondays - Fridays inclusive, before 8am or after 1pm on Saturdays or at any time on Sundays or Bank Holidays.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities of the area and the occupiers of neighbouring properties and ensure compliance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D14 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1 & D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Construction Vehicles</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall not commence until details
of the provision to accommodate all site workers', visitors' and construction
vehicles and loading /unloading arrangements during the construction process
have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.&nbsp; The approved details must be
implemented and complied with for the duration of the construction process.</span></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles
and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan
2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Tree Replacement</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The proposed new trees as shown on drawing&nbsp;</span></span>DPA-7278-04 (Rev A) contained within the approved Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report by DPA arboricultural consultants&nbsp; dated April 2026 shall be planted&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">within the first available
planting season following the implementation of the development.&nbsp;</span></p><p style="text-align: justify; "><u>Reason</u>:&nbsp; To enhance
the appearance of the development in the interest of the amenities of the area
and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy
G7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies O15.1, O15.2 and O15.4 of the Local
Plan 2024.</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Site Supervision (Trees) </span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Site supervision shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Arboricultural Impact Assessment by DPA Arboricultural Consultants (dated April 2026)</span></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; </span></span><span style="font-size: 14px;">To protect
and safeguard the existing retained trees in accordance with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies
O15.1, O15.2 and O15.4 of the Local Plan 2024.&nbsp;</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:

description: Refurbishment and extension of existing property including extension to the ground and first floor, removal of external staircase, replacement of windows, demolition of swimming pool structure and replacement with leisure room in the rear garden.
